_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Droe neuh Pemain {player_id} lam permainan LinesOfAction.
Bijeh-bijeh droe neuh '{side}', bijeh lawan '{other}'.
Format gerakan: `[b1b3]` (dari-koord ke-koord). Gerakan nyang sah bejalan horizontal, vertikal, atawa diagonal ngon banyaknya petak nyang sama ngon jumlah bijeh (warna ngon na) lam garis nyan. Droe neuh jeu-jump bijeh droe neuh, tapi hana bijeh lawan; tamong bijeh lawan nyan meukeusah.  Meunang keuh apabila bijeh-bijeh droe neuh hubong ngon 8-tetangga.

invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Gerak jih harus lurus atau diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Harus bergerak jarak sama dengan potongan bak garis.
invalid_move.destination_own: Tujuan jih di duek le awak droe.
